Overall, I think Tokyo is a wonderful and comfortable city to live in.

issues.currentValue: Since coming to Japan, half a year has flown by in the blink of an eye. In the beginning, even reading Hiragana and Katakana was difficult, and I didn't understand station signs or how to buy tickets. However, by studying at Japanese language school every day, I was able to complete all 30 lessons of the textbook. Remembering the rules of verb Te-form, Ta-form, and Nai-form was tough, but now I have become able to have everyday conversations with friends. I also learned a lot about Japanese customs and seasonal events. Next month, I will finally take the JLPT N5 exam. From now on as well, I will not give up and will continue reviewing, and next year I want to challenge N4.
